_about: Why a source or a material could not be read (C2-9, D-0043, D-0047). media_causes: the closed list of causes an `inspect --inspection-status unavailable --reason "<cause>: <fact>"` may carry. access_causes: the causes about ACCESS the person can restore - they are asked. default_causes: the causes the factory itself can establish (a code carrier, a structural fact, a measured size, a standing decision) - a point with such a cause is a gap in the report and is not asked; the value names the carrier the predicate checks (`probe`: a vcs_evidence receipt, `structural`: the URL shape, `size`: a measured size at or above the limit). `forbidden_by_policy` is NOT here on purpose: nothing in the package records a standing decision it could be checked against, so a role's word alone is never a default and the point is asked (FR-59). vcs_codes: every code vcs_evidence.py answers with -> the cause it means; a code not in this table is never a default.

media_causes.no_tool: nothing in this run can open that kind of address
media_causes.auth_required: a login page, a redirect to SSO, 401 or 403
media_causes.host_unreachable: DNS or routing failed - this is what a dropped VPN looks like
media_causes.transient: a timeout or a 5xx that did not settle on retry
media_causes.too_large: fetched, but too large to keep as evidence
media_causes.forbidden_by_policy: the factory is not allowed to fetch this
